item.title: I’m really glad I can still play PS3 games now
item.author: invalid@example.com (shifure)
item.dc:creator: shifure
item.content:encoded: When it comes to PS3 games, I've always felt the graphics look blurry and the framerate sits around 25 fps. But I play them every day and still think they're great. It feels so good, because I constantly see people claiming 30 fps is unplayable, yet in The Ballad of Gay Tony I can still drive skillfully, pull off precise skydives, and get a ton of satisfaction from it. Does anyone else feel the same way, like they're just lucky to still be able to enjoy these low framerate games?
